{{Top}}
[[File:Serp_shield.png|thumb|Luke Skywalker hits an archaic shield with a lance.]]
{{Quote|Blast! He blocked my energy bolt with his shield!|Luke Skywalker during a jousting contest on Serphidi|<ref name="SW64">[[Star Wars (1977) 64|''Star Wars'' (1977) 64]]</ref>}}
A '''shield''' was a broad piece of hard material carried on the [[Limb/Legends|arm]] and used as a protection against blows.<ref name="SW64" /> As early as by the [[Mandalorian Wars]], physical shields had been replaced by [[Personal energy shield/Legends|energetic devices]].<ref name="KORCG">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> Some [[Technology level|less-developed]] cultures, however, retained those archaic means of defense. Such civiliations included the [[Serp]], a [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Serphidi/Legends|Serphidi]], who still used kite-shaped shields for their jousting contests.<ref name="SW64" /> A [[Cortosis shield/Legends|certain type]] of shields made from [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]] [[Ore/Legends|ore]] also remained in use concurrently with modern technology due to its property of blocking [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] attacks.<ref name="AOW1">[[Jedi Council: Acts of War 1|''Jedi Council: Acts of War'' 1]]</ref> The [[beastwarden's shield]] was a type of shield made of [[Bronze/Legends|bronze]] with a serrated edge that was used for defense and as a thrown weapon by [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Petranaki/Legends|Petranaki]] [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiators]] on the planet [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]].<ref name="GATORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> Before their [[Speciecide|extermination]] by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mandalorian Crusaders|Crusaders]],<ref name="TEGW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> the [[Tlönian]]s crafted a [[Tlönian escutcheon|particular type]] of shield.<ref name="Skyewalkers">''[[SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story]]''</ref>

Also see [[Riot shield/Legends]]
